messages.subject: ggplot2 mailing list now available via GMANE
parts:
For those of you, like me, who prefer an NNTP interface for following a
mailing list (rather than following via direct email, RSS, or web
forum), I have created a gateway for this list at GMANE under
gmane.comp.lang.r.ggplot2.

nntp://news.gmane.org/gmane.comp.lang.r.ggplot2

GMANE also offers web versions (frames and threads; blog-like flat
interface), RSS feeds, and archives. These are accessible at
http://dir.gmane.org/gmane.comp.lang.r.ggplot2

Note that this is a one-way interface; replies still need to go via
email to the list.

Also note this is just another interface to this list; it does not have
to affect how you currently use this list in any way if you don't want
it to.
